svg.title: Gemini 4 Carbon monthly coding bill
svg.desc: At identical usage, 27,600 US dollars at the current tariff and 55,200 dollars from December 1.

g.text: Gemini 4 Carbon doubles the bill on 1 December
Modeled monthly spend · direct Standard API · 100,000 coding requests
Each request uses 128,000 uncached input tokens and 2,000 output tokens.
Source: Google AI Studio pricing, checked 23 November 2026. December tariff is scheduled.
